Hey everyone, I just wanted to introduce myself. My name is Kevin, I was almost a purdue alumni in computer science when my brother and I took a leave of absence to cofound a defi startup called Personafi. We built PersonaFi to help people invest in their future, to help them achieve their financial goals and become a better investor and trader. We know that the future of investing is social. Why not start now. 

We have a ton of new features we are building on the blockchain for Personafi. That are really exciting! So, I want to be a source of help in any way I can for anyone here in the crypto space and hopefully with anything else if I can. 

Hopefully, we can win some people over who use twitter to start using Personafi in how they use social media to find information in crypto and stocks.
